A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''senior agent''' of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] was captured by the [[Exchange]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], and the Exchange offered to sell him to both the Republic and the Empire. After the Republic offered full pardons for several imprisoned criminals, the Exchange returned the agent.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Diplomacy|Tug of War}}</ref>
